A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the suicide mortality in the studied populations is not determined solely by the migration but rather by the change of the socio-political situation.

the suicide rates for the Russian minority in independent Estonia are not lower than the rates for the population of Russia, but they are lower than for the local Estonians.
